finish_summary:
- `apply_discount` does not round to two decimals; it keeps full precision.
- `bulk_discount_percent(50)` incorrectly returns 5 instead of 10 as per spec.
- `parse_coupon("SAVE5 ")` raises ValueError due to trailing space; spec says whitespace should be ignored.
- `Cart.items()` returns a dict mapping item names to quantity only, not (unit_price, quantity) tuple. Hence assertions expecting tuple fail.
- Removing an item that would reduce quantity below zero does not raise ValueError; instead it silently removes the item.
